project_type: npm-workspaces monorepo: shared (@mlb/shared domain types + seed), backend (@mlb/backend Lambda handlers + MLB client + predict + Bedrock), frontend (@mlb/frontend Vite React SPA), infra (@mlb/infra AWS CDK). Strict TS, ESM everywhere.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts orchestrate ordered builds shared->backend->frontend->infra. node is on PATH at /usr/local/bin/node but npm is NOT: prefix every npm command with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". Playwright chromium may need `npx playwright install chromium` once.
test_framework: Vitest for unit + property tests colocated as *.test.ts / *.property.test.ts. Playwright for e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts (headless chromium --no-sandbox). Mock AWS SDK + MLB API; NO live calls in tests (use captured fixtures).
test_command: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test  (all workspaces vitest). E2E: PATH=... npm run test:e2e -w frontend. Synth: PATH=... npm run synth
verification_instructions: Per .kiro/steering/testing.md: npm run build, npm test, npm run synth must all stay green before a change is done. Add unit tests next to code; e2e in frontend/e2e. This issue adds infra so `npm run synth` (cdk synth, no AWS calls) is a real check now.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist is produced by the frontend build and must exist at synth time (BucketDeployment Source.asset(FRONTEND_DIST)). No committed snapshots. infra/cdk.out is generated by synth.
setup_instructions: From repo root with the nvm PATH prefix: `npm install` if node_modules stale (already present), then `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run synth`. For e2e: `npx playwright install chromium` once, then `npm run test:e2e -w frontend`.
environment_constraints: network_mode OPEN_INTERNET (live MLB curl allowed for one-off shape confirmation only; tests MUST use fixtures). Do NOT run cdk deploy. Do NOT make live MLB/Bedrock calls in tests.
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always and MANDATORY: incremental commits on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; truthful specs/README (update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md and BOTH README.md and README.ja.md); domain types live ONLY in @mlb/shared; strict TS; kebab-case modules, PascalCase components; Lambda handlers named by action (getGameDetail). Spec-driven dev is graded.
key_patterns: Backend handler pattern: `const service = new BracketService(); export const handler: APIGatewayProxyHandlerV2 = async (event) => {...}` returning jsonResponse(status, body) with CORS headers (backend/src/handlers/http.ts). Query parse helpers in http.ts (parseSeason etc). Service collaborators are injectable via a deps object for testing (BracketServiceDeps: store, fetchSchedule, fetchStandings, bedrockInvoker). DynamoBracketStore caches by pk (BRACKET#<season>, STANDINGS#<season>) with numeric ttl epoch seconds and no-ops when TABLE_NAME unset. MLB client (backend/src/mlb/client.ts) uses global fetch, throws MlbApiError on non-200, narrows raw response to consumed subset. Frontend api.ts: requestJson<T> wrapper throwing ApiError; getBracket falls back to seed. i18n: messages.ts has a union of keys plus en/ja records; useI18n()/t()/teamName()/teamAbbr(). SeriesDetailPage renders DetailGame list; add accordion there. e2e fixtures.ts has stubBracket2026 + SAMPLE_2026_FINAL_SERIES_ID with games gamePk 800001/800002.
mlb_api_shapes: linescore GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/game/{gamePk}/linescore -> { innings:[{num,ordinalNum,home:{runs,hits,errors},away:{runs,hits,errors}}], teams:{home:{runs,hits,errors,isWinner},away:{...}} }. feed/live GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/{gamePk}/feed/live -> { gameData:{venue:{name},status:{abstractGameState}}, liveData:{decisions:{winner:{fullName},loser:{fullName},save?:{fullName}}} }. content GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/game/{gamePk}/content -> { editorial:{recap:{mlb:{url,headline}}} } (OPTIONAL highlights/recap link). Decisions (W/L/S) are NOT in boxscore; use feed/live. Venue is also in boxscore info[] but feed/live gameData.venue.name is cleaner and gives status in the same call.
directory_structure: shared/src (types.ts, index.ts, season.ts, seed/), backend/src/{mlb,service,handlers,store,predict,bedrock}, frontend/src/{pages,components,i18n}, frontend/e2e, infra/{lib,bin,test}.
